Name: T's Extended Cellar (Formerly Joja's Extended Cellar)
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[center][size=5][color=#ffff00]This mod was previously known as[/color]
[color=#6fa8dc][CP] Joja's Extended Cellar[/color]
[color=#ffff00]but it has been completely revamped![/color][/size][/center]
[line]
[size=5][b]About This Mod[/b][/size]

[b][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50043]T's Core 2.0.3[/url] or later is required to use this mod.[/size][/b]

The cellar has been beautifully renovated with improved walls and flooring, and it's now slightly larger than before.
You can choose between [b]Vanilla Style[/b] and [b]Joja Style[/b] through the Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM).
You can also customize the farming areas and several other features.
If enabled in the settings, you can freely change the cellar's wallpaper and flooring using their respective in-game items.
If you choose to add a water trough, you can freely customize its placement.

[color=#ffff00][size=4][b]Important Notes for Users Upgrading from Joja's Extended Cellar[/b][/size][/color]
If you have an existing save that uses [b]Joja's Extended Cellar[/b], please be aware that switching to this mod will shift the farming areas [b]one tile downward[/b].
Other placed furniture, crops, and similar items will be preserved, so there's no need to worry about losing them.
[b]When upgrading from Joja's Extended Cellar, be sure to delete the old mod folder before installing this version.[/b]
If both [b][CP] Joja's Extended Cellar[/b] and [b][CP] T's Extended Cellar[/b] are installed, patches from both mods may be applied, potentially causing the cellar map to display incorrectly.

[size=4][b]Languages[/b][/size]
This mod includes English (default.json) and Japanese translations.
[line]
